messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy] PROD deployment started
- environment: prod
- commit: 4f7e3adec
- tag: release/v3.4.7
- initiated_by: maria
- plan: canary 5% -> 30% -> 70% -> 100%

maria: Kicking off canary. I'll monitor error budget and latency.

jon: Watching infra metrics / autoscaler. Thresholds: p50 > 200ms or error rate > 0.5% triggers hold.

deploy-bot: Canary reached 5% traffic (00:00:23)

maria: Canary stable at 5% after 2m. Proceeding to 30%.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift -> 30% (00:02:45)

lee: Heads-up: marketing change window in ~30m. Keep rollback plan handy.

jon: Seeing a transient p95 spike in us-west-2 (~320ms). Correlating with a background job spike. Investigating.

maria: Hold at 30% for now while we validate. Pls update in-thread.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by maria (manual hold)

jon: Root cause: indexer batch ran on shared GPU hosts causing contention. Isolating job to maintenance pool now.

jon: p95 dropping back to normal (180-220ms). No increase in 5xx.

maria: Good catch. Resume rollout to 70%.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift -> 70% (00:08:10)

maria: Monitoring post-shift. If stable for 5m, I'll continue to 100%.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift -> 100% (00:12:34)

deploy-bot: [deploy] PROD deployment complete
- commit: 4f7e3adec
- tag: release/v3.4.7
- duration: 00:14:12
- result: success
- pinned: yes (maria)

maria: Pinned release tag and pushed release notes: https://confluence.redwood.ai/releases/v3.4.7

ci-bot: Artifacts archived -> s3://redwood-releases/4f7e3adec-release-v3.4.7.tar.gz

lee: Nice work team :tada:

jon: Will keep an eye on infra for next 2h, but things look healthy so far.

maria: I'll open a quick follow-up doc about the indexer isolation tweak so we don't regress. Thanks all.
